facts.fact: A revenue-management digitalisation tool proven in Benin was presented on 25 March 2025 for a pilot in Conakry's 13 urban communes plus Coyah and Kindia; the article says the communes will experiment with it, so it is announced, not live.

facts.fact: The president of Kindia's special delegation says financing remains to be found; no budget line or donor is stated.
